cohort: 189 Asian women with singleton pregnancies planned for elective cesarean section between 37+0 and 38+6 weeks gestation.
finding: Antenatal dexamethasone given prior to early term elective CS did not significantly reduce the incidence of neonatal respiratory support, NICU admission, or length of stay.
mod_finding: Elective CS at early term before 39 weeks was associated with a modest overall incidence of neonatal respiratory illness (10.1%) in this Asian population.
